name: Emberfield Roast
purpose: Online storefront for a small coffee roaster: a catalog of coffees with photos, prices, roast level and origin, a guest-first cart and checkout, and order history for signed-in customers.

entities.name: Product
relationships: has one attached image or an external image URL
stores name, slug, sku, description, price_cents, currency, roast_level, origin, inventory, active

entities.name: Order
relationships: belongs to a user (optional, guest checkout allowed)
records state, email, totals, legal acceptance, public receipt reference, checkout key digest
guest receipt reachable via signed expiring access token

entities.name: LineItem
relationships: snapshots product name, sku, unit price, quantity, line total

workflows.name: Browse catalog
workflows.description: Guest or signed-in visitor sees coffees with photos, roast level, origin, and price, and opens a product detail page.

workflows.name: Add to cart and checkout
workflows.description: Visitor adds items with quantity, reviews the cart, and checks out with an email; no account required. Demo checkout completes through the local test simulator with no card data.

workflows.name: View past orders
workflows.description: Signed-in customer sees their own past orders and receipts; guests reach a receipt via a signed, expiring access link.

seed_demo: Six coffees (single origin and blends) with roast level, origin, price, and external photo URLs; one demo customer account with a past paid order and line items so order history is visible immediately.
